sources_note: Roster: QHĐ VIII điều chỉnh (QĐ 768/QĐ-TTg, 15/4/2025) via its implementation plan QĐ 1509/QĐ-BCT (30/5/2025, caselaw.vn) for coal/gas/LNG project tables; English Wikipedia 'List of power stations in Vietnam' for existing plants; news 2025–2026 for status/COD. Coordinates: OpenStreetMap (Overpass API query 26/11/2026; plant outline centres or generator nodes) preferred; otherwise Global Energy Monitor wiki values as surfaced through web search (gem.wiki blocks direct fetch, so values were not re-read on the page). coord_precision records exact/site-level/approximate. GEM points that looked city- or district-level were NOT used (lat/lon null, value kept in notes). Plants sharing a site carry the same point (Ô Môn II–IV, Miền Trung I–II, Long An I–II, Quảng Trạch II–III, Vĩnh Tân 4/4MR). Exclusions: Kiên Giang 1&2 (cancelled, not in QĐ 768), small captive/waste-heat units (Vedan, Hòa Phát, Thống Nhất steel), cancelled coal projects. Reserve LNG projects (QĐ 1509 Bảng 2) included as planned and flagged in notes. MW/COD/owner for some older plants differ across sources — see notes; cod null = not verified. 'cod' is a year (int) for operating/firm targets, a range string for plan windows.
